capability.description: Calls TheMealDB's fixed free search endpoint with one meal-name query. HTTP 2xx/3xx responses produce a success envelope; HTTP 4xx/5xx responses produce an error envelope and a non-zero exit; request exceptions also produce an error envelope and a non-zero exit.
capability.problem_space: Meal recipe discovery by name; not nutrition calculation, dietary safety advice, or ingredient substitution planning.

constraint.io_signature: Input: one meal-name query; output: JSON envelope containing http_status and TheMealDB recipe response or HTTP error body. HTTP 2xx/3xx responses produce a success envelope; HTTP 4xx/5xx responses produce an error envelope and a non-zero exit; request exceptions also produce an error envelope and a non-zero exit.
accepted_inputs: one meal name or partial-name string
constraint.output_shape: HTTP 2xx/3xx: {status: "success", tool: string, url: string, http_status: integer, result: object|string}. HTTP 4xx/5xx: {status: "error", tool: string, url: string, http_status: integer, result: object|string}, exit 1. Request exception: {status: "error", tool: string, message: string}, exit 1.
limitations: fixed GET https://www.themealdb.com/api/json/v1/1/search.php with s=<query>; no ingredient, category, area, id, or pagination filter
HTTP 2xx/3xx responses produce a success envelope; HTTP 4xx/5xx responses produce an error envelope and a non-zero exit; request exceptions also produce an error envelope and a non-zero exit.
wrapper preserves the API response without local parsing or truncation
free endpoint has no caller auth but is rate-limited by the provider; no cache or retry

output_contract.description: JSON envelope containing TheMealDB meal recipe search result, URL, and HTTP status.

intent_tags: find a recipe by meal name
negative_intents: calculate nutrition or give dietary medical advice

output_contract.description: JSON envelope containing TheMealDB meal recipe search result, URL, and HTTP status.
